title: Shopping for Food
content: Today is Saturday. Sarah goes to the supermarket. She needs food for the weekend. She buys apples, bananas, and oranges. She also buys milk, eggs, and bread. She wants to make a cake, so she buys sugar and flour. At the checkout, she pays with her credit card. The food costs 45 dollars. She puts the food in two big bags and walks home.

questions.question: Why does she buy sugar and flour?
questions.explanation: The text says: "She wants to make a cake, so she buys sugar and flour."

questions.question: How does she pay?
questions.explanation: The text says: "At the checkout, she pays with her credit card."

questions.question: How much does the food cost?
questions.explanation: The text says: "The food costs 45 dollars."
